integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible finite independent matrix tests; universal correctness does not rely on finite tests. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Positive common killing rates on simple unit-edge cycles only, with r dividing n. No uniqueness of minimizers, nondivisible lengths, unequal strengths or spectral optimality claim. Historical priority conditional on inaccessible 1978 original full text.
title: Equal-spacing minimax law for imperfect absorption on discrete cycles
